title: Guest App Branding
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — reactivate to edit.
saved: Saved. Changes reach your guests within a minute.
propagation: Changes appear to guests within a minute.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.help: Used for buttons, active navigation, and highlights in the guest app. We keep the design in control — you pick the hue.
accent.blocked: This color is too light for readable text and controls. Try the suggested shade below.

cover.label: Home cover photo
cover.hint: Optional. A wide photo works best — it will be cropped to 16:9. Without one, the clean default header stays.

welcome.title: Welcome message
welcome.help: One short line under the guest greeting. Arabic and English are required; other languages fall back to English.
welcome.moreLanguagesHint: Optional. Guests using these languages see the English message unless you translate it.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.caption: Built from the real guest app design — what you see is what guests get.

reset.confirmBody: The accent color, cover photo, and welcome message will return to the GXP defaults.
reset.consequence: Guests will see the default look within a minute. Your uploaded photo is removed.

logoNote.text: Your logo comes from the hotel profile so it stays consistent everywhere.
